state.review: Adversarial review of the selected definitive business/authority owner boundary. Treat the supplied row as a proposal; do not infer omitted policy.

owners.invariant: One independently approved, non-overlapping plan version line for a control.
owners.mustPreserve: Occurrence facts bind exact frozen plan and evidence requirements; one business window has one identity across all generators.

owners.invariant: Independent corrective-action lifecycle, evidence and completion proof.
owners.mustPreserve: Close only with at least one action, all complete, evidence/rationale present and independent closer unless exact waiver. Closed finding is immutable until reopen.

owners.invariant: One licensed text overlay and sequential revision line.
owners.mustPreserve: Exact prior revision and one request identity/intent; license/source proof validated per overlay.
Only independent accepted review can make a criterion not applicable; withdrawal restores coverage.

owners.declaredIdentity: Shared tenant+id address, foreign sentinels, RequestId creation identity. Semantic asset-list equality for immediate create retry but compares current state after revisions. Expected revision/physical OCC; no selected prior operation recognition.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant + caller DataFlowId under the preserved shared technology-inventory address/sentinel scheme.
owners.invariant: One tenant inventory identity has one record kind; flow endpoint/asset scope and encryption or approved-exception terms must match highest admitted carried classification, and effective date never moves backward.
owners.boundaryRationale: Shared type exclusion must remain in one physical slot. Complete carried-asset relation is evidence for one atomic encryption rule; asset identity/lifecycle remains separate. No reason for all flows to share a revision.

owners.invariant: Application creation, metadata revision, retirement and import admission generation.
owners.mustPreserve: Retirement requires an approved successor for exact app revision; import holds block incompatible local change.

logicalIdentity.rule: UUIDv5(source eventId, length-prefixed effectKind + canonical target stream + source lifecycle episode); external process callback source is the immutable accepted business source event plus exact effect key, never attemptId.

owners.declaredIdentity: Per instance minted/business id; declaration compares current fields, retirement rejects already-retired retry, revision commands have no selected logical request lookup.
owners.selectedIdentity: Tenant + caller SystemInstanceId with immutable owning application/program scope.
owners.invariant: One system instance has one immutable application parent and registered identity; metadata revisions and terminal retirement follow its own expected revision.
owners.boundaryRationale: Separating independent instances is already safe. Immutable parent binding and retirement gate belong with this instance, rather than parent roster state.

owners.declaredIdentity: UUIDv5 normalized address. Reserve owner retry safe; challenge issue handler mints random ID per invocation; recovery pair retry stable until overwritten. Expected-position OCC.
owners.selectedIdentity: Existing UUIDv5 of the normalized email address. ChallengeId and selected CommandId are distinct stable operation identities bound to this exact address, owner and recovery episode.
owners.invariant: A normalized address reserves exactly one platform user; verification requires its current challenge; a claimed recovery binds one old/replacement pair.
owners.boundaryRationale: Ownership and current-proof consumption require one authority; delivery outcomes do not. A recovery lifecycle can be separate only with durable claim/admission and revocation recovery.
